url.description: Original input URL requested for auditing.

status.description: Audit execution status (audited, blocked_ssrf, blocked_robots, error).

pageTitle.description: HTML document <title> of the audited page.

loadTimeMs.description: Total page audit duration in milliseconds.

errorMessage.description: Diagnostic error or security block reason when status is not audited.

legalRiskScore.description: Deterministic 0-100 legal & technical accessibility risk score.

riskTier.description: Risk tier classification: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW.

overlayDetected.description: Whether a third-party accessibility overlay widget was detected on the page.

overlayVendors.description: Detected overlay widget vendors (e.g. accessiBe, UserWay, AudioEye, EqualWeb).

overlayDetection.description: Detailed overlay detection breakdown and FTC/EAA regulatory note.

accessibilityStatementFound.description: Whether a multilingual EAA Accessibility Statement link was found.

accessibilityStatementUrl.description: Resolved URL of the detected Accessibility Statement page.

eaaCompliance.description: European Accessibility Act (EAA) statement disclosure check details.

summary.description: Aggregated counts of WCAG 2.2 violations by impact severity.

salesPitchHook.description: Ready-to-send 1-2 sentence English cold outreach hook for Clay, n8n, or Smartlead.

visualEvidenceKey.description: Apify Key-Value Store record key for the annotated PNG screenshot.

visualEvidenceUrl.description: Public URL to the annotated red-box visual evidence PNG.

visualEvidence.description: Metadata for the generated annotated visual evidence PNG (generated, key, url, highlightedCount, byteLength).

topViolations.description: Prioritized WCAG 2.2 violations with Before/After HTML remediation snippets and unified diffs.
